title: Chernobyl
lede: An HBO drama about the 1986 nuclear disaster, followed from the history people looked up to the trips they booked.
description: A time-ordered ripple map for Chernobyl: each step dated and marked by how it was measured.
limits: Wikipedia stands in for all attention and one city's library for borrowing. Timing shows order, not proof that the event caused each step on its own.
dataline: Wikimedia pageviews (daily), Seattle Public Library checkouts (monthly), tour operators via Smithsonian

steps.title: People look up the real disaster
steps.test: Named-subject test: z = 4 against 200 fake dates (p = 0.005); family passes (ledger 1458, 1470).
